options.description:
Skip automatic downloading of objects on clone or pull.
This requires a manual {command}`git lfs pull`
every time a new commit is checked out on your repository.
options.name: programs.git.lfs.skipSmudge

options.description:
Enable the automatic {command}`git maintenance`.

If you have SSH remotes, set {option}`programs.git.package` to a
git version with SSH support (eg: `pkgs.gitFull`).

See <https://git-scm.com/docs/git-maintenance>.
options.name: programs.git.maintenance.enable

options.description:
Repositories on which {command}`git maintenance` should run.

Should be a list of absolute paths.
options.name: programs.git.maintenance.repositories

options.description:
Systemd timers to create for scheduled {command}`git maintenance`.

Key is passed to `--schedule` argument in {command}`git maintenance run`
and value is passed to `Timer.OnCalendar` in `systemd.user.timers`.
options.name: programs.git.maintenance.timers

options.description:
The git package to use. Use {var}`pkgs.gitFull`
to gain access to {command}`git send-email` for instance.
options.name: programs.git.package

options.description:
Configuration written to {file}`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/git/config`.
This may be either a single attrset of Git settings or an ordered
list of attrset fragments when repeated sections or explicit
ordering matter.

See {manpage}`git-config(1)` for details.
options.name: programs.git.settings
options.type: (attribute set of attribute set of (string or boolean or signed integer or list of (string or boolean or signed integer) or attribute set of (string or boolean or signed integer or list of (string or boolean or signed integer)))) or list of attribute set of attribute set of (string or boolean or signed integer or list of (string or boolean or signed integer) or attribute set of (string or boolean or signed integer or list of (string or boolean or signed integer)))

options.description:
SSH public keys trusted when verifying signed commits and tags.

Each line must follow the allowed signers format described in
{manpage}`ssh-keygen(1)`. When non-empty, the content is written
to {file}`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/git/allowed_signers` and configured as
Git's `gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile` setting.
options.name: programs.git.signing.allowedSigners

options.default: if lib.versionAtLeast config.home.stateVersion "25.05" then null else "openpgp"
options.description:
The signing method to use when signing commits and tags.
Valid values are `openpgp` (OpenPGP/GnuPG), `ssh` (SSH), and `x509` (X.509 certificates).
options.name: programs.git.signing.format

options.description:
The default signing key fingerprint.

Set to `null` to let the signer decide what signing key
to use depending on commit’s author.
options.name: programs.git.signing.key

options.description: Whether commits and tags should be signed by default.
options.name: programs.git.signing.signByDefault

options.description: Path to signer binary to use.

options.description:
Set the mode of the shell integration. This accepts the same options
as the `shell_integration` option of Kitty. Note that
`no-rc` is always implied, unless this set to `null`. See
<https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/shell-integration>
for more details.
options.name: programs.kitty.shellIntegration.mode

options.description:
Apply a Kitty color theme. This option takes the file name of a theme
in `kitty-themes`, without the `.conf` suffix. See
<https://github.com/kovidgoyal/kitty-themes/tree/master/themes> for a
list of themes.

Note that if any automatic themes are configured via
`programs.kitty.autoThemeFiles`, Kitty will prefer them based on the
OS color scheme and they will override other color and background image
settings.
options.name: programs.kitty.themeFile

options.description:
The deployed config (the root-owned checkout systems are switched from): what the
outdated check reads, and one of the trees the pending refresh watches.
options.name: programs.nixin.authoritative

options.description: Whether to enable nixin, the package and option installer (nixin, nixin-tui, nixin-gui).
options.name: programs.nixin.enable

options.description:
The config's top directory, so that the index names the config's own files
relative to it (source `config`). Null: the source of the file that sets
`programs.nixin.enable` (the flake's store path, or /etc/nixos). Given as a
string or a path; a path is not copied to the store.
options.name: programs.nixin.optionIndex.configRoot
options.type: null or absolute path or string

options.description:
Write an index of every option of this Home Manager configuration to {file}`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nixin/options-home.json` when it is built (lib/options-index.nix). `nixin search --kind
hm`, `info` and `where` read it instead of asking
upstream or evaluating the config, and it includes the config's own options. Each
rebuild then also evaluates every option's documentation (README, "Modules", has
the cost measured on two configs).
options.name: programs.nixin.optionIndex.enable

options.description: The generated index (a derivation; passthru: doc, options, count).
options.name: programs.nixin.optionIndex.file

options.description:
Option paths whose sub-options the index leaves out (the option itself stays).
Home Manager's NixOS module would otherwise repeat every Home Manager option under
home-manager.users.<name>; homeModules.default indexes each user's own.
options.name: programs.nixin.optionIndex.prune

options.description:
Whether to enable a user timer that runs `nixin outdated` (the lock's next nixpkgs) and `nixin outdated
--published` (search.nixos.org) on the deployed config and keeps the result in
$XDG_STATE_HOME/nixin (summary.json, outdated-lock.json, outdated-published.json:
what bars and dashboards read; `nixin-state summary` prints it).
options.name: programs.nixin.outdated.enable

options.description: When the check runs (systemd OnCalendar), and 10 minutes after boot.
options.name: programs.nixin.outdated.interval

options.description: notify-send when the number of packages with a newer version changed.
options.name: programs.nixin.outdated.notify

options.description: How long the notification stays (ms); null: the notification daemon's default.
options.name: programs.nixin.outdated.notifyTimeout

options.description: Hours (H-H, local time) in which a notification waits for the next run.
options.name: programs.nixin.outdated.quietHours
options.type: null or string matching the pattern [0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}

options.description: The nixin package, built by default with this configuration's own pkgs.
options.name: programs.nixin.package

options.description:
Whether to enable a user timer that keeps `nixin status`'s pending block (unapplied commits and edits in
the workspace) in $XDG_STATE_HOME/nixin/status.json and summary.json, refreshed on an
interval and right after a switch or a commit in either tree.
options.name: programs.nixin.pending.enable

options.description: How often (systemd OnUnitActiveSec); a run with nothing changed is skipped.
options.name: programs.nixin.pending.interval

options.description:
The user's workspace clone of the config, for the pending refresh ($NIXIN_CONFIG).
Null: ~/nixos when it is a git checkout, else the deployed config (then nothing is
pending).
options.name: programs.nixin.workspace

options.description: Whether to enable OpenSSH private key agent.
options.name: services.ssh-agent.enable
